# Business Card Maker

Business card maker: design the front of a business card with your name, job title and contact details spelled out, in the look you want, ready to print or share.

## What it does
Give your name, job title, company and contact details and the look you want. Claude tells you the price and designs the front of the card with every word spelled as you wrote it.

**How the files are made:** each business card is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

The front of the card as an image file; the lettering is drawn by the model, so check it in the result.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install business-card-maker@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Business Card Maker talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/business-card/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each business card uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The business cards show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_business_card_models` | Models for business cards with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_business_card_cost` | Exact price of one business card before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_business_card` | Starts one business card in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_business_card` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Make a minimal business card for Anna Rossi, interior designer"
- "Design an elegant black and gold business card for my bakery"
- "Create a bold business card for a personal trainer"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the business card (the name, title, contact details and style) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
